prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Companion Archetype Studio: Redesign the pet friend picker into a character archetype stage layout with animated trait callouts and dynamic previews before final adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "label": "Choose Companion Archetype"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "style": "rounded", "asset": "asset:pet_archetype_preview"}]}}}
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Onboarding Goal Selector Flow: Introduce an intent goal selection screen prior to path selection, letting users define whether their pet is for productivity, entertainment, or focus.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_goal_selection", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_goal_selection": {"headline": "What is your companion's main mission?", "body": "Select how your desktop pet will assist you daily.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "emphasis", "label": "Select Companion Purpose", "action": "next"}]}, "choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Sandbox Screen: Add a hands-on sandbox screen at the finish step where users practice dragging, toggling visibility, and interacting with their pet before desktop deployment.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_interaction_sandbox"], "new_interaction_sandbox": {"headline": "Try Your Pet Controls", "body": "Practice moving your pet around and accessing command shortcuts right here.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded", "asset": "asset:interactive_sandbox_demo"}, {"type": "button", "style": "emphasis", "label": "Launch Pet to Desktop", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Async Generation Mini Game Flow: Add an interactive waiting room mini-game sub-screen during pet rendering so users remain active while waiting for desktop setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_waiting_minigame", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5}, "new_waiting_minigame": {"headline": "Play While Your Pet Prepares", "body": "Interact with toy elements while your custom pet renders in the background.", "layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful", "asset": "asset:mini_game_interactive"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Readiness Hub Redesign: Redesign home intro into a two-column readiness hub showing shortcuts, system tray locations, and quick toggle keys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "text", "style": "large", "text": "Your Companion is Ready!"}, {"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "label": "Essential Shortcuts & Controls"}]}}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Protection Hint: Display a prominent hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data from being lost upon app updates or reboots.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in anchors your companion data permanently to prevent pet progress loss on restart."}}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Verification Screen: Insert a photo quality check screen that validates lighting and crop before custom pet creation starts.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_checker", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"show_progress": true}, "new_photo_checker": {"headline": "Photo Clarity Check", "body": "We check lighting and background to make sure your custom pet generates perfectly.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "emphasis", "label": "Photo Quality Checklist"}, {"type": "button", "style": "rounded", "label": "Proceed with Photo", "action": "next"}]}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Audio Readiness Cue: Enable system alerts and an audio notification chime when background pet rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "style": "calm", "asset": "asset:ready_chime", "action": "play"}]}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode, displaying path benefits one featured card at a time.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight"}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "playful", "text": "Unlocks Exclusive Cloud Saved Crown Accessory"}]}}
